chunks: O Allah, we have come out to You to complain to You

what is not hidden from You, when the severe hardships have forced us, the drought-stricken famines have driven us, the difficult needs have made us helpless, and the troublesome tribulations have clung to us.
ai.seo_question: What is the Dua for Rain in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This supplication, attributed to Imam Ali (AS) in *Nahj al-Balagha*, exemplifies the Shia tradition of *Istisqa'* (seeking rain) by framing environmental distress as a spiritual opportunity for divine mercy. It highlights the theological concept that while Allah is fully aware of human hardships, the act of supplication serves to humble the believer and invite specific divine intervention during times of tribulation (*fitan*) and scarcity.
